title: Special closed meeting on CAO performance review
subtitle: A deputy clerk was appointed for the session, and no report came out of closed session.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on February 5, 2026, to meet in closed session about the CAO's performance review. The minutes describe the closed-session topic as a personal matter about an identifiable individual, including municipal employees.

Before the closed session, Council appointed Jess Fuhrman as Deputy Clerk for the meeting {{vote:m1}}. Council then voted to meet in private under section 239(2)(b) of the Municipal Act, 2001 {{vote:m2}}, and later returned to open session {{vote:m3}}.

After the closed session, the Mayor said that a session had been held and that no report will be coming forward. No decisions from the private discussion were made public, so residents should not expect further information on it from this meeting.

Council then passed the routine by-law confirming its proceedings {{vote:m4}} and adjourned {{vote:m5}}. No pecuniary interests were declared and no changes were made to the agenda. There were no delegations and no public debate on any item.

decisions.detail: Council appointed Jess Fuhrman as Deputy Clerk for the February 5, 2026 special closed Council meeting.
